title: platelet-percolation: simulator and semi-empirical model of the geometric percolation threshold of finite-thickness platelets
description: Monte Carlo simulator for the geometric percolation threshold of penetrable platelets of finite thickness, and a semi-empirical model of that threshold with five fitted constants (thickness, restacking, log-normal size dispersity, aligned domains and out-of-plane ripple). The release holds the calibration, the pre-registered tests, the sealed-exam records, the verification records of the independent reimplementation and the adversarial review, and the scripts that regenerate every number and figure of the accompanying paper.
